raw_html: [[Freezing Gale#Legendary Freezing Gale|Legendary Freezing Gale]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Freezing Gale#Legendary Freezing Gale|Legendary Freezing Gale]]:''' This weapon is imbued with a frigid wrath. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this freezing power will be released, dealing damage to the target and all enemies near it for 30d6 + 90 cold damage. A successful Will save (DC 100) reduces this by half.
